dreamGuide.title: Dream Interpretation Guide
dreamGuide.subtitle: Explore dream symbols and meanings, learn how to remember your dreams better

intro.title: What are dreams?
intro.paragraph1: Dreams are messages from our subconscious mind. Emotions, memories, and desires experienced during the day appear as symbolic images at night.
intro.paragraph2: Dreamics.ai analyzes your dreams using AI technology and visualizes them into beautiful webtoon stories.

moon.title: Moon
moon.meaning: Symbolizes the subconscious, intuition, and femininity. A bright moon in dreams can mean discovering inner wisdom.

heart.title: Heart
heart.meaning: Represents love, passion, and emotional connection. Heart symbols may be messages about relationships or self-love.

brain.title: Brain
brain.meaning: Symbolizes intelligence, logic, and problem-solving abilities. Dreams featuring brains suggest important decisions need to be made.

sparkles.title: Sparkles
sparkles.meaning: Means hope, inspiration, and new beginnings. Sparkling lights are signs of positive change.

cloud.title: Cloud
cloud.meaning: Represents uncertainty, confusion, or unclear situations. Clouds clearing mean problem resolution.

stars.title: Stars
stars.meaning: Symbolize dreams, goals, and spiritual guidance. A starry sky means infinite possibilities.

lucid.title: Lucid Dream
lucid.description: A dream where you're aware you're dreaming. Some can control dream content.
lucid.tips: Suggesting 'I will remember my dreams' before sleep increases lucid dream chances.

nightmare.title: Nightmare
nightmare.description: Dreams reflecting fear, anxiety, and stress. Often symbolically express real-life problems.
nightmare.tips: Nightmares are the unconscious mind trying to process unresolved emotions. Recording and analyzing them helps find causes.

recurring.title: Recurring Dream
recurring.description: Dreams with the same theme or situation repeatedly appearing. Indicates unresolved issues.
recurring.tips: Recording recurring dream patterns helps understand messages the unconscious is trying to convey.

prophetic.title: Prophetic Dream
prophetic.description: Dreams that feel like they predict the future. May actually be results of unconscious reasoning.
prophetic.tips: Prophetic dreams result from intuition and pattern recognition. Keeping a dream journal improves intuition.

remember.title: How to Remember Dreams Better
remember.tip1: Keep a dream journal by your bed and record dreams immediately upon waking.
remember.tip2: Maintain regular sleep patterns by going to bed and waking up at the same time daily.
remember.tip3: Before sleep, mentally affirm 'I will remember my dreams.'
remember.tip4: Waking naturally without alarms helps remember dreams better.
remember.tip5: Avoid caffeine and alcohol before bed as they reduce dream quality.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to your questions about Dreamics.ai

q1.question: What is Dreamics.ai?
q1.answer: Dreamics.ai is an AI-powered dream storytelling and webtoon generation platform. Your dreams are analyzed by AI and visualized as 4-panel webtoons and stories.

q2.question: Can I use it for free?
q2.answer: Yes! Basic dream recording and standard style webtoon generation are free. Premium styles (Ghibli, Marvel, etc.) and AI story expansion features are available with paid subscriptions.

q3.question: What styles of webtoons can I create?
q3.answer: We offer various styles including Pixar, Ghibli, Marvel, Manga, Watercolor, and Lego. Each style has its unique feel and atmosphere.

q4.question: Is my dream data stored securely?
q4.answer: Yes, all dream data is encrypted and stored securely. We prioritize privacy and never share with third parties without user consent.

q5.question: How long does webtoon generation take?
q5.answer: Typically takes about 30 seconds to 1 minute. May take slightly longer depending on server conditions.

q6.question: Can I download generated webtoons?
q6.answer: Yes, generated webtoons can be downloaded as image files. High-quality downloads available with paid subscriptions.

q7.question: How does AI analyze dreams?
q7.answer: Uses Natural Language Processing (NLP) to analyze dream content, emotions, and symbols. Combines psychological dream interpretation theories with AI learning data for meaningful analysis.

q8.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
q8.answer: Yes, you can cancel anytime. Click 'Manage Subscription' on PricingPage to cancel via Polar subscription management.

q9.question: Do you support multiple languages?
q9.answer: Yes, we support Korean, English, Japanese, and Chinese. Language is auto-detected or can be changed manually in the header.

q10.question: Can I input dreams by voice?
q10.answer: Yes, click the microphone icon on the homepage to input dreams by voice. Speech recognition converts to text.
